source.note: Response-only case: ImageInboundTransformer(generation).TransformResponse turning a unified llm.Response (one b64+data-URL image, one https URL image) into the OpenAI ImagesResponse client wire shape. inbound_http, unified_request, selected_channel, outbound_http and upstream_http are null because the inbound response unit test does not exercise those stages. unified_response is an extension field recording the INPUT llm.Response fixture.

unified_response._comment: Verbatim transcription of the llm.Response literal the Go test feeds to TransformResponse (L269-283): Created 123, Image{Created 123, Data:[{B64JSON 'AAA', URL 'data:image/png;base64,AAA'}, {URL 'https://example.com/a.png'}]}.

client_http._comment: Expected client HTTP response. Byte-asserted by the Go test: StatusCode==200, body unmarshals to ImagesResponse with Created==123, len(Data)==2, Data[0].B64JSON=='AAA', Data[1].URL=='https://example.com/a.png'. Derived from image_inbound.go TransformResponse (not separately byte-asserted): Data[0].url passthrough of the data URL; Content-Type/Cache-Control headers (L176-183).
